title: Wynn Palace Becomes the First in Macao to Debut on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 Extended 51-100 List Underscoring the resort's position as a benchmark for luxury hospitality

body_markdown:
*Underscoring the resort's position as a benchmark for luxury hospitality*


**Macao, September 2, 2026** – Wynn Palace has been named No.96 on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 extended 51–100 list, becoming the first hotel in Macao to be recognized in the prestigious global award. The accolade recognizes Wynn Palace's commitment to bespoke hospitality, world-class gastronomy and resort experiences. This prestigious international distinction further reinforces the resort's position as a benchmark for luxury hospitality in Macao and beyond, while supporting Macao's development as World Centre of Tourism and Leisure.


As the world's largest Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star resort, Wynn Palace features 1,706 exquisitely furnished rooms, suites and villas, complemented by its signature large-scale floral sculptures and rare art pieces. Alongside Macao's largest spa and Wynn Esplanade featuring world-renowned brands. Guests are invited to discover Wynn Palace's signature collection of multi-sensory attractions, from the iconic Performance Lake and SkyCab to Illuminarium, an immersive, interactive attraction that captivates visitors with its stunning visual experiences.


The resort experience is further elevated by an extraordinary culinary landscape. Wynn Palace houses an array of award-winning signature restaurants, including Chef Tam's Seasons, currently the only restaurant in Macao featured on Asia's 50 Best Restaurants list. Together with Asia's most celebrated culinary landmark Gourmet Pavilion, casual eateries and a stylish bar, further positioning Macao as a Creative City of Gastronomy. Complementing these exceptional experiences, every moment of the stay is defined by world-class service tailored to create unforgettable guest journeys.


The World's 50 Best Hotels extended 51-100 list was curated by The World's 50 Best Hotels Academy. Following its introduction in 2025, the second edition of the extended list features fifty additional industry-defining hotels from six continents. The World's 50 Best Hotels Academy is a global panel of more than 800 independent experts, each selected for their insight into the international hotel landscape.
